opening.argument: The video presents a creator testing and documenting purported tech-support scammers, not offering their cancellation, charging, data-entry, or reimbursement process to the audience. The caller’s claims are examined as evidence of the alleged scam mechanism: “A big part of this scam hinges on. You thinking that. No one's on your computer that way you. Log into your bank account.” The caller also requests a full home address and bank name while describing cancellation as eligibility for reimbursement. Although the presenter’s segment visibly includes banking screens, those images do not establish that the pages were authentic, that credentials or security answers were submitted, or that any financial outcome occurred. The available evidence therefore supports an investigation or test of scam tactics, with the purported offer treated as material under examination rather than promoted as an offer to purchase or join.
